body: Chief: shape approved with one correction. Do not reuse Missing(Excluded) for a malformed/wrong-space provider outcome — Excluded means excluded by policy (unprepared source, mode gate), and callers must be able to tell policy exclusion from provider defect. Use a distinct reason case (e.g. Missing(Malformed(kind))) — if the reason ADT lacks one, add it (explicit ok for that vocabulary; note it in the ADR 0001 result-algebra line). Defaulted result-decisions field on AttemptReceipt.of is acceptable; I am adding a note on bd-01M1508J0F8ZAMHH3G9X20W8ZV so the HMAC covers it. Bijection/reorder/whole-batch-fail on missing/duplicate/extra/unknown ids: exactly as decided.
